title: Judge image
description: The POOR judge image in skins/judge. default: MISS from beatoraja simple-play (mnpy) default3; default1 / default2 / default4: its POOR images. Add your own with tools/import_judges.py and list its name here.

title: Trim empty space
description: Crop the image to the visible text so the overlay box hugs it.

title: Show time (ms)
description: beatoraja shows a judge for 500 ms.

title: lr2hp-for-osu overlay folder
description: Folder name of the lr2hp-for-osu overlay in tosu/static. Key layout and empty POOR settings are taken from it.
